name: peppynose-shop
description: Peppynose own online shop (local development only until approved). Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute peppynose_shop --local --file=db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute peppynose_shop --local --file=dist-db/seed.sql
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:reset && wrangler dev --local --port 8787
